name: Hahnenkamm Reutte
kurzbeschreibung: The Bergwelt Hahnenkamm in Höfen near Reutte at 1,938 m above sea level delights with an 8-seater gondola, alpine barefoot trail, and alpine flower garden.
preis: Berg- und Talfahrt Erwachsene ca. 31,00 €, Kinder ca. 13,00 €; Erlebnisweg frei
oeffnungszeiten: Ende Mai bis Anfang Nov täglich 08:30–16:30 Uhr
beschreibung:
Overview

The Hahnenkamm bei Reutte (also known as Höfener Hahnenkamm) is a distinctive, 1,938-metre-high panoramic and adventure mountain in the Tannheimer Berge in the Tyrolean Außerfern. Situated right in the municipality of Höfen near Reutte, the Bergwelt Hahnenkamm forms a multifaceted excursion destination for families, leisure hikers, and mountain enthusiasts. From the summit ridge, a breathtaking 360-degree panoramic view opens up over the Reutte valley basin, the Lechtaler Alpen, the Plansee, and the adjacent Allgäu pre-Alps.

Attractions & Barefoot Trail

The modern 8-seater gondola of the Hahnenkammbahn Höfen overcomes an elevation gain of nearly 800 metres over a route length of around 2,300 metres, carrying visitors from the valley station (940 m) up to the mountain station on the Höfener Alm plateau at 1,730 metres above sea level in about ten minutes. A widely celebrated attraction is the Alpine Barfußwanderweg: along a circular route of about one kilometre around the idyllic mountain lake, visitors can feel the alpine mountain nature directly with their bare feet. The path encompasses 21 lovingly curated sensory stations, including tactile paths made of bark mulch, pebbles, wood slices, and pine cones, refreshing spring-water Kneipp pools following Sebastian Kneipp, and a wooden foot-washing station at the finish. Botany enthusiasts appreciate the adjacent Alpenblumengarten, which showcases rare high-alpine plants like gentian, mountain avens, and edelweiss against their natural rock backdrop. For leisure hikers, excellently marked trails lead up to the Hahnenkamm summit cross (1,938 m) or onward to the Schneetalalm.

Visit & Getting There

The Hahnenkammbahn Höfen runs continuously during the summer season from late May to early November daily from 08:30 to 16:30 (in winter the area provides skiing operations until April). Fares for summer 2025/2026 (round-trip ascent and descent): adults approx. €31.00, seniors approx. €28.00, children approx. €13.00, toddlers travel free; dogs on a leash with a muzzle ride free of charge. Use of the alpine barefoot trail and the alpine flower garden is included free of charge with the cable car ticket. Arrival by car: via the B179 (Fernpassstraße) to Reutte, then on the L260 to Höfen to the valley station (large free parking lot available directly at the cable car). By public transport: ÖBB/Außerfernbahn to Reutte in Tirol station, from where VVT regional bus routes 100/110 run directly to the Höfen Hahnenkammbahn stop.

Tips

The 8-seater gondola and the panoramic restaurant at the mountain station are barrier-free and wheelchair-accessible; the panoramic trail around the mountain lake is level and navigable with all-terrain strollers. Pack a small towel in your backpack for the barefoot trail to dry your feet after the Kneipp pools. Traditional Außerfern delicacies are served on the sun terrace of the panoramic restaurant.
